pitch.heading: Year 380 of the Unlidding
pitch.text: Two thousand years ago a seed fell on the Ghessil Uplands and did not go out. Its light stops time in stone and slows it in flesh. You are a cutter of Quell, in debt; your uncle has stood eleven months in an open granary vault under the glass, alive. Under the plateau a citadel is building itself downward, and above it something is coming down the light.
